mechanism: Both drugs cause significant hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances (particularly calcium and phosphate), with foscarnet also causing hypomagnesemia and hypokalemia, increasing risk of serious metabolic complications and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, magnesium, and potassium closely; consider alternative antivirals if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; obtain baseline and periodic ECGs.
